# z1engine

A C++17 game engine for Windows and macOS — OpenGL rendering through a deferred/forward render graph, an ImGui editor, EnTT ECS, Python 3.14 scripting, and PhysX physics. Built with Premake5 and, since March 2026, developed largely by AI agents working through a spec-driven workflow.

## Features

### Rendering

- **Render graph** — dependency-driven pass scheduling with reusable framebuffers
- **Dual pipelines** — deferred G-buffer pipeline and forward pipeline, both using Cook-Torrance PBR (metallic-roughness and spec-gloss workflows, alpha blend/cutoff modes)
- **Shadows** — cascaded shadow maps (CSM) with Poisson-disk PCF soft shadows; GPU particles can cast and receive shadows
- **Ambient occlusion** — SSAO and Jimenez GTAO at half resolution with optional blur, tunable from the editor
- **Reflections & IBL** — screen-space reflections (deferred) and image-based lighting from HDR sky probes (SH irradiance + prefiltered specular)
- **Post-processing** — bloom, modern TAA (jitter compensation, adaptive blending, variance clipping, sharpening), tone mapping, motion-velocity buffers, post-process volumes
- **Particles** — GPU-instanced billboard particles: burst, loop, gravity, damping, cone emission

### Editor & Tooling

- **ImGui editor** — viewport with picking and gizmos, scene hierarchy, reflection-driven properties inspector
- **Material editor** — live procedural-sphere preview with orbit camera, per-variable editing and save/persistence
- **Content browser** — asset creation, renaming, deletion, thumbnails
- **Asset pipeline** — GUID-addressed assets, glTF/OBJ/PNG/TGA/EXR importers, offline `bakery` CLI + importer GUI, engine binary format
- **Shader tooling** — GLSL include system, shader variants, and a validation tool

### Gameplay & Systems

- **ECS (EnTT)** — reflected components (`REFLECTED_COMPONENT` / `REFLECTED_FIELD`), systems for animation, particles, post-processing, physics, and scripts
- **Skeletal animation** — skinned meshes with animation playback
- **Physics** — PhysX 5.6 integration: colliders, rigid bodies, fixed-timestep simulation
- **Scenes & prefabs** — YAML scene serialization, prefab instantiation
- **Python scripting** — Python 3.14 via pybind11, bindings auto-generated from the reflection system, input API, `on_attach`/`on_update`/`on_detach` lifecycle

### Engineering

- **Job system** — named thread contexts (game/file), priorities, and async asset loading (`AssetHandle<T>`: Loading/Ready/Failed)
- **Profiling & benchmarking** — `PROFILE_*` instrumentation and benchmark regression gates
- **Testing** — auto-discovered unit test suites, editor smoke tests, shader validation
- **Dev CLI** — `python dev/z1.py`: generate, compile, format, validate-shaders, test, smoke, benchmark, dcv, release, gen-pybinds

## Getting Started

### Windows

Prerequisites: Windows 10/11, Visual Studio 2022 or 2026 (Desktop C++ workload), Git, Python 3.14 (bundled with the project).

```cmd
git clone https://github.com/LuniumLuk/z1engine.git
cd z1engine
python dev/z1.py generate          # generate VS projects via premake5
python dev/z1.py compile           # build (Debug default; --config Release|Profile)
run_editor.bat                     # launch the editor
run_game.bat                       # launch the game (optional: scene name)
```

Verify the build:

```cmd
python dev/z1.py test              # unit test suites
python dev/z1.py validate-shaders  # GLSL validation
python dev/z1.py smoke --frames 10 # editor smoke test
python dev/z1.py dcv --auto        # full develop-compile-verify loop
```

### macOS

Prerequisites: Xcode Command Line Tools, Python 3.14.

```bash
./generate.sh
./compile.sh
./run_editor.sh
./run_game.sh
```

## Project Structure

| Directory | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `engine/runtime/` | Core engine: rendering, ECS, assets, scripting |
| `engine/editor/` | ImGui editor |
| `engine/game/` | Game executable (also hosts the editor) |
| `engine/bakery/` | Offline asset baking CLI |
| `engine/test/` | Unit tests (`test_*.cpp`, auto-discovered) |
| `engine/3rdparty/` | Bundled libraries (GLFW, ImGui, EnTT, GLM, yaml-cpp, PhysX, ...) |
| `dev/` | Dev CLI (`z1.py`) and its commands |
| `openspec/` | Spec-driven changes, knowledge base, archives |
| `content/`, `asset/` | Runtime content and source assets |

## Scripting in Python

Scripts live in `content/scripts/`:

```python
import z1

class MyScript(z1.Script):
    def on_update(self, dt):
        if z1.input.is_key_pressed(z1.input.KEY_W):
            t = self.entity.transform
            t.location.y += dt
            self.entity.transform = t
```

Attach the script via a `ScriptComponent` in the editor. Run `python dev/z1.py gen-pybinds` to regenerate bindings after changing reflected components.
